Cheers! Beerbrewing
Beer Expanded

Introduction
Beerbrewing works differently here. You need to soak your grain in water, let it germinate, malt the germinated grain, and then cook the malt together with water to obtain wort.
This wort can then ferment in a barrel into beer.

The type of beer you get depends on the malt you use (light or dark) and if you put any other ingredients into the wort.

Currently, only 3 types of beer are obtainable and the only other ingredient other than malt and water is honey to obtain maltbeer
